attempts.summary: Configured sudo command logging on node1 to /var/log/sudo-commands.log (with user, host, and timestamp per entry) while suppressing those entries from the general system log (auth.log/journal), via a validated /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging drop-in. Performed the mandatory single-node restart with proof of a changed boot identity and confirmed the logging configuration and behavior persisted after reboot.
